title: Explicit preorder bar total
statement: Let C be a preadditive category with zero object and small coproducts, as for complexes of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For a small preorder I and a diagram D of integer cochain complexes in C, define B_p(D) as the coproduct of D(i_0) over monotone strings i_0 <= ... <= i_p. Its simplicial maps use D on the first arrow when the first vertex changes. The bar total has total degree q-p and vertical sign (-1)^p. It has the canonical augmentation associated to any cocone of D, and reindexing maps associated to order maps and compatible natural transformations.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Explicit preorder bar total.

proof.text: Form the coproduct for each simplex. A simplex operator restricts the string and applies the diagram map from its old first vertex to its new first vertex. Functoriality follows on each coproduct injection. Apply Mathlib alternatingFaceMapComplex and totalization with degree q-p and vertical sign (-1)^p. The augmented alternating-face-map map followed by collapse of the single column defines the augmentation. Coproduct and total-generator extensionality prove naturality and composition of reindexing.
